questions.questionTextEn: The strait which separates Asia from North America is—
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P. Lower Sub. (Pre) 2004] The strait which separates Asia from North America is—
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) Bering Strait. Bering Strait separates Asia from North America. It is located at easternmost point of Russia at 169043' east longitude and western end (Alaska) of USA at 168005' west longitude. 85 Km wide strait connects the Chukchi Sea (part of the Arctic Ocean) in the north with the Bering Sea (part of the Pacific Ocean) in the south. [U.P. Lower Sub. (Pre) 2004]

questions.questionTextEn: Which one of the following waterways has more economic and strategic significance?
questions.questionTextHi: [M.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 2021] Which one of the following waterways has more economic and strategic significance?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C) Suez canal. The "Suez Canal" is one of the world's largest artifi cial canals built in the Isthmus of Suez of Egypt. Due to the construction of this canal, the distance between Europe and India has reduced by 7000 kms. About 12% of global trade passes through it, representing 30% of all global container traﬃ c annually. [M.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 2021]

questions.questionTextEn: Through which one of the following straits does a tunnel connect the United Kingdom and France ?
questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. (Pre) 2007 ; U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2007] Through which one of the following straits does a tunnel connect the United Kingdom and France ?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C) Strait of Dover. Dover Strait marks the boundary between the English channel and the North Sea. There are three marine tunnels through Dover Strait on the eastern part of English channel which connect England and France. These tunnels connect Folkestone in Kent of England with Coquelles in Pas-de- Calais of France. [I.A.S. (Pre) 2007 ; U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2007]

questions.questionTextEn: Which strait connects the Red Sea and the Indian Ocean?
questions.questionTextHi: [53rd to 55th B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2011] Which strait connects the Red Sea and the Indian Ocean?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) Bab-el-Mandeb. Bab el-Mandeb Strait connects the Red Sea to the Indian Ocean (Gulf of Aden). The Strait of Hormuz links the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman. The Strait of Malacca connects the Indian Ocean (Andaman Sea) to the South China Sea. [53rd to 55th B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2011]

questions.questionTextEn: Lombok Strait is located between which two islands?
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P. R.O./A.R.O. (Mains) 2017] Lombok Strait is located between which two islands?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) Bali and Lombok. The Lombok Strait is a strait connecting the Java Sea to the Indian Ocean and is located between the Islands of Bali and Lombok in Indonesia. The Canals A canal is a manmade waterway that allows boats and ships to pass from one body of water to another. Canals are also used to transport water for irrigation and other human uses.*Suez Canal has been constructed on the Isthmus of Suez and is the largest man-made canal in the world. [U.P. R.O./A.R.O. (Mains) 2017]
